question: Which of the fruits shown in the 2008 painting "Embroidery from Uzbekistan" were served as part of the October 1949 breakfast menu for the ocean liner that was later used as a floating prop for the film "The Last Voyage"? Give the items as a comma-separated list, ordering them in clockwise order based on their arrangement in the painting starting from the 12 o'clock position. Use the plural form of each fruit.

Zooming the image, visible fruits include pears (in a central/front bowl and another bowl nearer the top) and a curved cluster of bananas in a glass bowl toward the right side. Fruit items listed on the breakfast menu include: apples, bananas, pears, oranges, grapefruit, honey dew, and raisins (listed as red raisin and white raisin). These appear alongside juices (orange, grapefruit, pineapple, tomato) and various jams/marmalades, but the core fruit offerings are as above.
